investigations.name: biogears-hemorrhage
investigations.title: Hemorrhage and resuscitation in the BioGears engine
investigations.description: Three studies on the biogears_hemorrhage and biogears_resuscitation composites, run through the workbench and recorded in each study's runs.db. Their pass criteria are pytest files in each study's tests/ directory, written after a 2026-11-16 pilot of every arm (the same composites and parameters, run directly) and fixed before the canonical runs.

investigations.name: biogears-timestep
investigations.title: BioGears' solver time step - accuracy and speed
investigations.description: Both studies run the same composite at time_step_s 0.02, 0.04 and 0.08 (the new time_step_s parameter of every viva-biogears process, passed to BioGears through pybiogears' configuration override) and compare each run with the 0.02 s run. Their criteria were written after a pilot of every arm (workspace/experiments/timestep-pilot-2026-11-16).

investigations.name: mcdaniel-2019
investigations.title: Replicating McDaniel et al. 2019 (sepsis in BioGears) on BioGears 8.2.0
investigations.description: Three studies on the biogears_sepsis composite. Its treatment parameter runs the paper's protocols (viva_biogears.protocols, TreatmentController). The progression arms run 48 h from t = 0; as in the paper, every treatment arm starts from the severe infection's state saved at 44 h (viva_biogears/states/StandardMale@severe-infection-44h.xml) and runs 8-20 h. mcdaniel-2019-sepsis/run.py runs the same arms outside the workbench, and analyze.py draws the paper's figures. Fig 8 (inflammation parameter changes) needs changes inside BioGears and is out of scope.
